interpretation: This is a design-only traceability classification for a proposed limited language specification. Partial means that only a defined subset or protocol rule is addressed. No row claims full product completion, working support, measured behavior, or owner ratification. Deferred requirements retain their original source priority and remain part of the broader roadmap.

treatment_definitions.language_subset: The core language defines a limited part of the requirement; material exclusions and all implementation evidence remain outstanding.
treatment_definitions.agent_contract: The draft defines or records an authoring, inspection, validation, provenance, support, or documentation contract; no working service or product conformance is claimed.
treatment_definitions.deferred: The requested capability is outside this version of the core; its product requirement is preserved without executable support or complete domain semantics.

included: One source module with finite declarations
Single nominal inheritance and independent instances
Typed parameters and immutable derived properties
Pure functions and methods returning core values or Action descriptions
Unit-checked numeric, vector, point, rotation, and pose values
Separate ownership, follow relationships, named sites, and prescribed fixed/hinge/slider connections
Sphere and box geometry with simple color; visible box geometry may use an explicit sphere_body physical proxy
Prescribed move, spin, and joint tween actions
Uniform rigid-sphere bodies with authored mass, derived isotropic inertia, and passive free flight under uniform gravity with isotropic rotation
Static timeline and specified action lifecycle
Native source authority, agent operation contracts, and structured diagnostics
excluded: Runtime allocation, procedural generators, loops, and external imports
Box-body dynamics and non-spherical dynamic body models
Dynamic joints, motors, load transmission, closed mechanisms, and physical controllers
External force, torque, impulse, and general field syntax
Locomotion, inverse kinematics, wind, fluids, and deformation
Geometry import, mesh processing, skinning, and texture/shading systems
Rendering, animation export, interchange formats, and engine integrations
scope.implementation_choices: No compiler, host language, parser technology, solver, physics engine, rendering engine, target application, or interchange format is selected.

Mass is authored; the core fixes a sphere's center at its origin and derives its isotropic inertia. Automatic density-to-mass derivation, hollow/composite distributions, and non-spherical body models are deferred.
Only physical values required by the sphere model are defined; friction, restitution, complex presets, and material calibration are deferred.
Collision and contact detection or response are disabled for every core object.

There is no continuous collision handling or tunneling-protection guarantee because collisions are disabled.

Physical material-pair interactions and pair overrides are unavailable.
No solver quality controls or measured execution profile is selected.

Spinning geometry is not a wheel/axle rolling-contact model; tire and drive mechanics are unavailable.
Vehicle steering, braking, propulsion, suspension, and associated controllers are unavailable.
Gear, pulley, linkage, and other load-transmitting couplings are outside the core.
Dynamic closed mechanisms, redundant-constraint analysis, and loop solving are unavailable.
Only prescribed translation, spin, and joint targets are defined; load-aware machine goals are unavailable.
The prescribed grip can release a supported sphere; general trailers, tools, and dynamic assembly attachment are deferred.
Core capability limits are declared; no tested customization range for machine components exists.
Tracked and alternative vehicle locomotion profiles are outside the core.
Breakage, wear, damage, and physical failure rules are unavailable.
